title: Estera
claim: Estera — an AI receptionist that answers a business's phone calls and WhatsApp 24/7 (Product Hunt launch, 129 upvotes).
why_good: Missed calls are directly lost revenue for clinics, salons and contractors, and WhatsApp-first coverage targets the markets US-centric AI-phone startups neglect.
value: Per-line SaaS with obvious ROI math — one saved booking pays the month; land via WhatsApp Business in LatAm/EU/SEA, then expand into scheduling and CRM.
risk: The AI-receptionist field is already crowded with funded lookalikes, differentiation is thin, and telephony incumbents (Twilio, RingCentral) or Meta can bundle the same thing.
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score
